#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file
read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email builds its link from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment. This explains why reset links point to localhost in production for the reporter and teammates. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/validated for production deployments (or the fallback removed in favor of a required config value) so templates.ts doesn't silently default to localhost.
